note.explanation: An entrepreneur starts and runs a new business or organization. Entrepreneurs identify a need, develop an idea, and take a risk to make it real. Their businesses can create jobs, support economic growth, and bring new ideas and products.
examples: A neighborhood bakery started to serve its community is a local example of entrepreneurship.
Facebook, Google, and Apple began as small tech companies founded by entrepreneurs with innovative ideas.
note.checkAnswer: The word entrepreneur comes from a French word meaning “to undertake.” Entrepreneurs undertake the task of starting and running new businesses.
note.simple: An entrepreneur spots a need, thinks of a way to meet it, and starts a business—even though it might not succeed.
note.checkQuestion: What is the origin and meaning of the word entrepreneur?
note.title: Entrepreneurship and why it matters
steps: Spot a need in the market.
Think of a product, process, or service that could meet that need.
Take the risk of starting a business or organization.
Run the business and create value for customers.
note.answer: Entrepreneurship is the process of starting a new business or organization. It can create jobs, support economic growth, and encourage innovation.

options: Finding a market need and starting a business to meet it
Working only for an established company
Avoiding all new ideas
Buying products only for personal use
rationales: This is correct because entrepreneurship involves identifying a need and starting a business to meet it.
This is incorrect because working for an established company does not by itself mean starting a business.
This is incorrect because entrepreneurs are innovators who look for new or improved ways to solve problems.
This is incorrect because buying products for personal use is not starting and running a business.

options: Keeping every product exactly as it is
Creating something new or improving what already exists
Avoiding customer problems
Taking no interest in change
mcqs.stem: What does innovation mean in this section?
rationales: This is incorrect because innovation involves change or improvement, not keeping everything unchanged.
This is correct because the section defines innovation as creating something new or improving something that already exists.
This is incorrect because entrepreneurs look for ways to solve problems.
This is incorrect because innovation requires looking for new or better ways of doing things.

options: Knowing that a new business might fail but being willing to try
Refusing to make any business decisions
Only choosing ideas that have no chance of change
Stopping whenever a problem appears
mcqs.stem: Which behaviour best shows an entrepreneur's willingness to take risks?
rationales: This is correct because starting a business involves risk, including the possibility of failure.
This is incorrect because refusing to make decisions prevents a person from bringing a business idea to life.
This is incorrect because entrepreneurs take chances rather than avoiding every uncertain situation.
This is incorrect because entrepreneurs are problem-solvers and must work through challenges.

options: A small neighborhood bakery
A person buying bread for home
A student reading about businesses
A customer visiting a clothing shop
mcqs.stem: Which is an example of a local business that can represent entrepreneurship?
rationales: This is correct because the section names a neighborhood bakery as an example of a local entrepreneurial business.
This is incorrect because buying bread is a customer activity, not starting a business.
This is incorrect because reading about businesses does not itself create or run one.
This is incorrect because visiting a shop makes someone a customer, not the entrepreneur running the shop.

options: It helps entrepreneurs create jobs and provide new products and services
It ensures that all businesses sell the same products
It removes the need for new ideas
It stops competition between businesses
mcqs.stem: How can entrepreneurship contribute to economic growth?
rationales: This is correct because new businesses can create jobs and provide products and services.
This is incorrect because entrepreneurship can bring fresh ideas and competition, not make every business identical.
This is incorrect because entrepreneurship fosters innovation and new ideas.
This is incorrect because the section explains that new businesses bring competition.

options: A smartphone changing communication and access to information
A bakery selling its usual bread
A person choosing not to start a business
A shop closing without offering a new service
mcqs.stem: Which example from the section shows innovation changing how people live and work?
rationales: This is correct because the section says the smartphone revolutionized communication and access to information.
This is incorrect because selling bread is an example of a local business, not the stated example of innovation changing how people live and work.
This is incorrect because not starting a business does not show entrepreneurial innovation.
This is incorrect because closing a shop and offering no new service does not demonstrate innovation.

explain.title: What entrepreneurship means
explain.body: Entrepreneurship is the process of starting a new business or organization. An entrepreneur identifies a need, develops an idea to meet it, and takes the risk of bringing that idea to life.

explain.title: The qualities entrepreneurs need
explain.body: Key characteristics refer to the essential traits or qualities that define a particular role or person. In the context of entrepreneurs, key characteristics are those fundamental attributes that are commonly found in successful entrepreneurs. These include innovation and risk-taking. Innovation means creating something new or improving something that already exists.

explain.title: Why entrepreneurship matters
explain.body: Entrepreneurship drives economic growth, creates jobs, and fosters innovation. New businesses bring fresh ideas and competition, which can lead to better products and services.

explain.title: Examples in the section
explain.body: Tech startups such as Facebook, Google, and Apple began as small companies with innovative ideas. Local businesses such as a neighborhood bakery or a small clothing boutique are also examples of entrepreneurship.

mistakes: Do not define entrepreneurship only as buying and selling; include starting a new business or organization.
Do not say entrepreneurs avoid risk; starting a business involves the possibility of failure.
Do not give only an example when asked to explain importance; link entrepreneurship to jobs, products and services, economic growth, or innovation.
Do not confuse innovation with keeping things unchanged; it means creating something new or improving what already exists.
